verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a framework and its CLI tooling, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to disable Next.js telemetry or usage tracking. The OpenTelemetry item covers instrumenting your own app, which is an adjacent feature and not an opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
